import re

def extract_order_ids(text: str) -> list[str]:
    pattern = re.compile(r"ORD-(201[5-9]|202[0-9])-([0-9]{6})")
    result: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for match in pattern.finditer(text):
        start, end = match.span()
        if start > 0:
            prev = text[start - 1]
            if prev.isalnum() or prev in "-_":
                continue
        if end < len(text):
            nxt = text[end]
            if nxt.isalnum() or nxt in "-_":
                continue
        order_id = match.group(0)
        if order_id in seen:
            continue
        digits = match.group(2)
        if sum(int(d) for d in digits[:-1]) % 10 != int(digits[-1]):
            continue
        seen.add(order_id)
        result.append(order_id)
    return result

```python
def extract_order_ids(text: str) -> list[str]:
    import re

    pattern = re.compile(r"ORD-(201[5-9]|202[0-9])-([0-9]{6})")
    found = []
    seen = set()

    for match in pattern.finditer(text):
        start, end = match.span()

        if start > 0:
            prev = text[start - 1]
            if prev.isalnum() or prev in "-_":
                continue

        if end < len(text):
            nxt = text[end]
            if nxt.isalnum() or nxt in "-_":
                continue

        order_id = match.group(0)
        if order_id in seen:
            continue

        digits = match.group(2)
        if sum(int(ch) for ch in digits[:-1]) % 10 != int(digits[-1]):
            continue

        seen.add(order_id)
        found.append(order_id)

    return found
```
